category_description: Superannuation and the Age Pension in Australia.
subcategory_description: How super works, and the limits on putting money into it.
label: Super guarantee rate
context: The minimum percentage of an eligible employee's qualifying earnings that an employer must pay into super. Employers pay it on each payday from 1 July 2026.

category_description: Superannuation and the Age Pension in Australia.
subcategory_description: How super works, and the limits on putting money into it.
label: Maximum super contribution base (annual)
context: The most of an employee's earnings in a financial year on which an employer has to pay the minimum super guarantee. It is worked out from the concessional contributions cap and rounded down to the nearest 10 dollars.
